datasets.extraction_method: Rotate original source PDF by its 90-degree page matrix. x frame [46.48822,250.58301] or [329.95300,534.04700] pt maps to [-1000,1000] microrad. y0=245.267105 pt; one 200-count tick interval is19.130905/18.695908 pt for e-/e+. Recover100 uniform bin-centre heights from coloured horizontal steps.
datasets.estimated_precision: Approx0.1microrad axis calibration and1arbitrary count. Physical/model uncertainties not supplied by this digitisation.
datasets.limitations: Native signed global theta. Do not silently convert positron sign or arbitrary counts to rates.

datasets.extraction_method: Same rotated x frame maps to[-pi,pi] rad. y0=245.267105 pt;500-count tick intervals33.798309/33.764908 pt. Recover100 uniform bins.
datasets.estimated_precision: Approx1e-4rad axis calibration and1arbitrary count; source raw event definition is not recoverable.
datasets.limitations: Native published azimuthal shape including broad tails, not independently validated as a matched-momentum kick. Right source x-axis typo says delta theta but title/caption identify phi.

datasets.extraction_method: PyMuPDF vector filled-circle path centres. Crop offset(+50,+45) restores published PDF coordinates. log10(theta/rad)=affine fit of PDF x at [121.858,201.461,281.184] to [-2,-1,0]; log10(pT/GeV)=affine fit of PDF y at [233.653,165.267,96.882] to [-3,-2,-1].
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Conservative half-width 0.005 dex for each coordinate. Extra CSV decimals are computational, not accuracy.
datasets.limitations: Published positron markers only; USSC500GeV configuration and E>5MeV. No event identities, weights or total-normalisation inference. Original small-angle convention preserved; theta_near equals theta in visible hemisphere but folding of backward hemisphere undocumented.

datasets.extraction_method: Rotated-PDF coloured marker batches. Convert y via P=.8+(57.733-y)*.005/(120.518997-57.733); same linear axis for both panels. Separate legend markers by batch length.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Conservative P half-width 0.0001; finite symbol shape and rendering determine this estimate.
datasets.limitations: Electron 500GeV collision case. RDR0/TDR0/TDRstar0 have no energy spread/loss; star changes initial spin alignment. These are STALC/Bmad/Guinea-Pig++ results, not CAIN.

datasets.extraction_method: Rotated-PDF coloured marker batches. Convert y via P=.8+(57.733-y)*.005/(120.518997-57.733); same linear axis for both panels. Separate legend markers by batch length.

datasets.limitations: Electron 500GeV collision case. RDR0/TDR0/TDRstar0 have no energy spread/loss; star changes initial spin alignment. These are STALC/Bmad/Guinea-Pig++ results, not CAIN.

datasets.extraction_method: Subtract matched incoming and luminosity-weighted Pz per scenario; store percentage points and relative percent separately.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Conservative difference half-width0.02 percentage points from two0.0001 P uncertainties.
datasets.limitations: Derived graphic values only, not a new simulation. Error bound excludes original Monte Carlo and physics uncertainties.

datasets.extraction_method: Red filled-circle vector centres; E=160+(x-70.03689575)*90/(550.41900635-70.03689575); P=.8+(19.196-y)*.14/(212.3991089-19.196). Blue horizontal mean independently extracted.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Conservative energy half-width0.1GeV and P half-width0.0005.
datasets.limitations: Mean profile; original error bars and event sample not reconstructed. Excludes legend and out-of-frame boundary markers. Spent single-electron energy, not collision energy.

datasets.extraction_method: Vector horizontal step intervals, both ILC red and CLIC black. Full x=(X-96.5)/(483-96.5); log-density affine fit to y=[85,162,239,316,392.75], logf=[2,1,0,-1,-2]. Peak x=.98+(X-96.5)*.03/425; f=200+(284-Y)*400/218. Convert GeV axes using nominal energies1000/3000.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Full: x half-width0.0007, log-density half-width0.008dex. Peak: x half-width0.00002, density half-width0.6.
datasets.limitations: Display-floor/baseline rows explicitly flagged. Normalised density, not raw counts. Only plotted horizontal segments, not an original histogram; sparse clipped tail and coalesced equal bins possible. Peak and full plots have different binning; do not splice directly.

datasets.extraction_method: Manual exact transcription of five historical CAIN parameter sets.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Printed rounding0.01 percentage points; no added uncertainty assigned.
datasets.limitations: Fully polarised incident beams, head-on collisions; values are not ILC250 predictions.

datasets.extraction_method: Manual exact transcription, retaining CLIC comparisons and each contribution.
datasets.estimated_digitisation_precision: Source quotes approximately0.10 percentage-point absolute statistical uncertainty; printed rounding is finer.
datasets.limitations: Fully polarised incident beams. Coherent and incoherent secondary-particle terms affect population definition; no apples-to-apples uncertainty claim across distinct parameter sets.
Counts are number of secondary electrons plus positrons per BX, not number of pairs; effective cross sections include finite beam-size suppression.

datasets.extraction_method: Manual exact transcription of N, sigma_x/y/z and mean Upsilon for four historical ILC/CLIC cases.
datasets.limitations: Characteristic average Upsilon; not chi_max or a photon chi mean. No chi_gamma distribution inferred; no extrapolation to ILC250/LCF.

datasets.method: vector_marker_centres
datasets.calibration: Rotated PDF x: phi=(x-240.236)/52.1075 rad; ticks -2,0,+2. y: frame bottom/top 351.762/20.599 pt = 4/18 microrad.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Conservative graphical reading scale: 0.02 rad and 0.3 microrad (FCC) or 0.1 microrad (LEP).
datasets.notes: Only Guinea-Pig marker centres; independent black numerical-integration curve is retained in source asset, not treated as a second dataset. Legend marker excluded by y range.

datasets.method: vector_histogram_segments
datasets.calibration: Rotated PDF x: phi=(x-240.236)/52.1075 rad; ticks -2,0,+2. y frame 4..18 microrad.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Conservative graphical reading 0.02 rad and 0.3 microrad (FCC) or 0.1 microrad (LEP).
datasets.notes: Independent numerical-integration black stepped curve in original figure; these are binwise means, not particle events.

datasets.method: vector_histogram_segments
datasets.calibration: Rotated frame x=76.5354..403.937 pt maps to -20..30 microrad; y=351.762..20.599 maps to 0..100000 a.u.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Conservative ordinate precision about 1% of peak; horizontal bin edges within 0.1 microrad.
datasets.notes: Bin segments retain source arbitrary ordinate units; no event count or luminosity normalisation is inferred. Negative/zero bins are retained; unequal merged zero segments may occur.

datasets.method: vector_histogram_top_edges
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Conservative 0.5 MeV bin-edge precision and 2% ordinate digitisation; Monte Carlo fluctuations remain and are not digitisation uncertainty.
datasets.notes: Source calls ordinate Distribution. Values are plotted histogram heights, not absolute luminosity. Log floor is 1; missing subthreshold/empty bins not invented. Source describes CM energy using Eplus+Eminus, so crossing-angle invariant-mass corrections are not recoverable from this figure alone. Recovered ZHV RMS=24.77 MeV differs from Table 3 value21.52 MeV; preserved unaltered and independently checked with lower-panel markers (24.74 MeV).

datasets.method: vector_marker_centres
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Conservative 40 micrometres and 2 MeV graphical precision.
datasets.notes: Each row is a plotted vector marker, not a recovered complete collision event. Hidden/overplotted markers can be present in vector PDF; no event identity, weights, momenta or ISR information exists. Legend markers excluded.

datasets.method: table_transcription
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Vertical size is explicitly approximate (~4 micrometres); other entries retain source rounding.
datasets.notes: Instantaneous-luminosity-weighted annual averages at the Z pole; not a time-resolved machine record.

datasets.method: table_transcription
datasets.calibration: Published decimal values copied; ratio computed from corresponding zero-dispersion baseline.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Published rounding, not digitisation error. No statistical uncertainties supplied.
datasets.notes: NIMA 2025 / arXiv v3 results; distinct from later IPAC2025 re-optimization. 2IP labels describe two monochromatised IPs in a four-IP machine.

datasets.method: table_transcription_and_derived_formula
datasets.calibration: lambda uses source Eq.(3) with BS equilibrium emittances, energy spread, beta, dispersion and tabulated Piwinski angle.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Rounded source values; derived lambda should be used only to about 2 significant figures.
datasets.notes: lambda is not identical to ratio of complete source baseline and monochromatised RMS spreads, because equilibrium emittances and energy spreads change.

datasets.method: table_transcription
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Published rounding only; no uncertainties supplied.
datasets.notes: Re-optimised beta_y with hourglass effects; single-pass Gaussian-input approximation, not multi-turn validation. Four monochromatised IPs.

datasets.method: table_transcription_and_derived_ratios
datasets.calibration: Published decimal entries; ratios use baseline 63.03 MeV and 25.28e34 cm^-2s^-1.
datasets.digitisation_uncertainty: Published rounding only; no error bars. Preliminary analytical optimization, not measured performance.
datasets.notes: Edited IPAC26 preprint; four-IP LCC v105 study. Beta_x entries in mm. Dedicated beam-beam simulation and coherent instability studies identified as future work.
